# FAQ-027 Engineering FAQ #27

Revision: Rev A

Q1: What is the required coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01)?
A1: The coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 81 L/min. Maintain this flow to prevent coil overheating and comply with the heater start-up checklist (see SOP-P2-L1-03).

Q2: What mandrel clamp bolt torque should be used for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01)?
A2: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 430 N·m. Apply using a calibrated torque wrench and verify against the maintenance record per SOP-P1-L2-02.

Q3: What is the system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02)?
A3: The system pressure limit for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is 295 bar. Do not exceed this limit; pressure transducer alarms and interlocks are configured accordingly (refer to ECN-2026-048 for control logic changes).

Q4: What is the coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02)?
A4: The coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02) is 46 L/min. Confirm flow during heater commissioning and document readings in the equipment log per SOP-P2-L1-03.

Q5: What target billet temperature is specified for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01)?
A5: The target billet temperature for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P2-L2-IH01) is 1230 °C. Use the calibrated pyrometer and follow the billet readiness procedure; any deviation or control changes must be processed via ECN-2026-048.

Related documents: ECN-2026-048, SOP-P1-L2-02, SOP-P2-L1-03
